projectedFromMargin: Projected from the margin — nothing is stored until this SKU is promoted.
providerInactiveHint: This SKU is switched off at the provider, so the product can't be sold until the provider re-enables it. Its selling price still follows the provider cost automatically.
noPricedPlans: No priced plans yet — set a margin and save.
mixSingleOnly: Product mix is only available in Single mode.
tipProductName: The denomination buyers see, e.g. “86 Diamonds”.
tipNickname: Optional per-product override for the account-name lookup. The username check is normally configured on the game/category (its “Cek Username” field), not here.
tipSubName: Optional secondary label shown under the product name.
tipProductCode: A unique internal SKU for this product (e.g. mlbb-86). Must not clash with another product.
tipAccess: Who may buy this product — e.g. everyone (public) or a specific member tier.
tipTag: An optional marketing badge shown on the product (e.g. Hot, Promo).
tipCategory: The game this product belongs to.
tipSubCategory: An optional grouping within the game (e.g. a denomination group). Pick a category first.
tipPoints: Loyalty points this product earns, as a percentage of the sale. Leave empty to use the global points setting; enter 0 for a product that earns nothing.
tipBonusPoints: Flat bonus points added on top of the percentage — what makes a cheap denomination worth anything at all. Leave empty to use the global setting.
formSubtitle: Create a nominal buyers can purchase, and file it under the game it belongs to.
basicInformationHint: Product name, code, access, and tags.
mediaDescriptionHint: Product logo and description shown on the storefront.
marginHint:
Margin per membership plan over the supplier’s cost. Leave one empty to fall back to the
                    pricing rules.
noPlans: No membership plans yet — create one before pricing a product.
dailyOrderLimitHint: Most orders this SKU takes per day. Empty = no limit, 0 = none today. Counted per WIB day; failed or expired orders release their slot.
mixHint: Combine main products into one bundled price.
deleteProviderDescription: This action cannot be undone. It permanently removes this provider mapping.
updateProductDescription: Re-pull this product's selling prices from its supplier cost.
archiveProductDescription: It leaves the storefront and the catalogue, and its provider SKU returns to the pool. Past orders keep their details, and you can restore it from the Archived filter.
marginUpdateFailed: Failed to update the product margin
poolFailed: Failed to add SKUs to the pool
bulkUpdateDescription: Re-pull selling prices from each product's supplier cost.
bulkShowDescription: The selected prices will be visible on the storefront.
mainProductsSubtitle: The nominals buyers can purchase for each game, with their variants, pricing and storefront availability.
noPlansSku: No membership plans yet — create one before pricing a SKU.
bulkSubtitle: Select a supplier and category, then choose the products to add.
selectSupplierFirst: Select a supplier and category first.
noProductsForSelection: No products available for this supplier and category.
setPriceLimitSubtitle: A lower and upper bound for this product's selling prices.
poolEmpty: No provider services match. Map the game under Category Provider first, or widen the filters.
poolSubtitle:
Provider services for the games you have mapped under Category Provider. Pick the ones to pull into the
          pool — nothing is priced or sold yet.
priceChangesEmpty: No price changes yet. The supplier sync records one here whenever a cost moves.
priceChangeLogSubtitle:
Every automatic price change from the supplier sync. Selling prices always follow the margin
          rules; watch for rows that need attention — a SKU switched off at the provider, or a margin gone negative.
bulkLockProviderDescription: The daily supplier sync will stop overwriting these products' prices until they are unlocked.
bulkDeleteProviderDescription: This action cannot be undone. System provider products in the selection are skipped.
providerSubtitle:
The provider products mapped into your catalog. Lock a price to hold it against the supplier sync, tune its
          profit margin, or remove a mapping. System products are managed by the platform.
addProductsSubtitle: Pick provider services, fill in the details, then publish or save them as drafts.
fromSupplierSubtitle: Pick provider services to add to your catalogue. They are created as DRAFTS — set the name, price and margin, then publish when they are ready.
discountHint: A standing price cut for this product, applied on top of the plan price. Leave the type empty for no discount.
tipSupplier: The provider the SKU comes from. Decides which rows appear below.
tipOurCategory: The catalogue category for this new product. Decides the Sub Category options.
tipSearchService: Search provider services by name or SKU code.
tipMode: Single adds one service; Bulk selects many at once. You can switch at any time.
tipColCodeSubCategory: The provider's SKU code, and an optional sub category in your catalogue (pick Category first).
tipColPointsDiscount: Loyalty points and the discount that apply to each service.
tipDiscountValue: The discount amount for the chosen type — a percentage of the price, or rupiah off.
tipPriceColumn: The supplier cost and the selling price per membership plan. Empty margin = follow the Pricing Rules; filled = your own percent.
tipCost: The supplier's cost — the base the selling price is calculated from.
tipMargin: Margin (%) over cost for this plan. Enter one to set your own percent; leave empty to follow the plan's Pricing Rules. The selling price is derived automatically.
tipLowerLimit: The lowest selling price. Empty or 0 means no limit.
tipUpperLimit: The highest selling price. Empty or 0 means no limit.
tipMix: Combine other main products into one bundled price.
tipMixProduct: The main product included in this bundle.
tipQuantity: How many of the product the bundle includes.
tipLogo: The product image shown on the storefront. Automatically converted to WebP.
reviewSubtitle: {{n}} product(s) will be added — check the details first.
reviewDraftNote: These products will be saved as DRAFTS. They are not visible on the storefront yet.
reviewPublishWarning: These products will go LIVE on the storefront right away.
reviewBlockedHint: Fill the required fields, then try again.
issueDefaultPrice: The default plan has no price — set a margin or a pricing rule.
issueMarginNoRule: {{plan}}: no margin and no pricing rule, so it sells at cost.
issueIncompleteMix: A mix row has no product selected.
issueDiscountValue: A discount type is set but the value is empty.
issueDiscountType: A discount value is set but the type is empty.
